title: Sorcerer pawn: Galvanize and cancelling a spell (DPC 0.9.175)
intro: A player: Galvanize on his played Sorcerer pawn doesn't restore stamina, and he can't cancel spells. You need a SORCERER pawn in the party (hire one at a riftstone, or switch a pawn's vocation). Outdoors, co-op off. A training dummy appears ahead. About 4 minutes. Press End to start.

steps.text: 1/4 Take control of your Sorcerer pawn yourself (F6 / L1 + left stick click on it). Then press End.

expect.label: vocation of the played pawn (6 = Sorcerer)

steps.text: 2/4 GALVANIZE: use up stamina (cast spells or sprint) until the bar is below half. Then stand still and HOLD the Galvanize button for 5 seconds (keyboard: V; on the controller it's the button the Sorcerer skill menu lists for Galvanize). Does the bar refill faster? End.

3/4 CANCEL: start chanting a spell on the dummy (L1 + a face button), and while it charges try, one at a time: B / Circle, then A / X (jump), then the Galvanize button. Do it a few times. Note which one stops the chant. End.
4/4 Done, back to the Arisen. Tell Claude what happened in steps 2 and 3. End.
